subject: english
prompt: Community-center announcement: ‘Because of rain, the outdoor yoga class will meet in Room 204 instead. The class still starts at 4:20. Please check in at the front desk ten minutes earlier.’ What is the new plan?

options.text: Attend yoga in Room 204 at 4:20 and check in at 4:10.
Go to the outdoor garden at 4:10; the class is canceled.
Check in at 4:20 and begin class at 4:30.
Move the class to Room 240 at 4:20.

answer.explanation: 雨天造成地點改到Room 204，但開課時間仍是4:20；提前十分鐘報到，所以應於4:10到櫃台報到。

examPatternRefs.observedPattern: 原卷第24題廣播中部分人員改變去向、其他安排仍照常；本題改寫為天候造成地點變更，要求整合新舊安排。

solutionStrategy: 把原因、改變項目與未改變項目分開，更新地點時不要順手假設時間也改了。
solutionSteps: 由 Because of rain 找到公告原因。
確認 instead 指向新地點 Room 204。
still 4:20 表示開課時間不變。
ten minutes earlier 表示報到時間是4:10。
同時符合新地點、上課時間與報到時間的是A。
